argv:
$ErrorActionPreference='Stop'
$repo='E:\WebAIBridge'
$git=(Get-Command git.exe -CommandType Application -ErrorAction Stop | Select-Object -First 1).Path
function G([string[]]$a){
  $o=& $git -C $repo @a 2>&1
  $c=$LASTEXITCODE
  if($c -ne 0){throw "git $($a -join ' ') failed ($c): $o"}
  if($null -eq $o){return ''}
  return ([string]($o -join [Environment]::NewLine)).Trim()
}
$head=G @('rev-parse','HEAD')
$branch=G @('branch','--show-current')
$origin=G @('remote','get-url','origin')
$status=G @('status','--porcelain=v1','--untracked-files=all')
function J([string]$u){try{return Invoke-RestMethod -Uri $u -Method Get -TimeoutSec 4}catch{return [pscustomobject]@{error=$_.Exception.Message}}}
$s=J 'http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/status'
$l=J 'http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/operator-lifecycle'
$c=J 'http://127.0.0.1:17448/api/projects/control-plane?inspect=0'
$r=[ordered]@{
  object='owner.r44.local_inspect.v1'
  repo=$repo
  head=$head
  branch=$branch
  detached=[string]::IsNullOrEmpty($branch)
  origin=$origin
  porcelain=$status
  status=$s
  lifecycle=$l
  control=$c
  mutationPerformed=$false
}
$r|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 30 -Compress
